name: AKB1/48: Idol to Koishitara...
original_name: AKB1/48 アイドルと恋したら・・・
source:
In AKB1/48 Idol to Koishitara, 48 girls are in love with you, the main character. And they aren’t going to wait for you to woo them. They all want to happily proclaim how much they love you. The thing is, you can only have one of them. So you have to avoid 47 girls so you can get with the one you want. 

[From [url=http://www.gamertell.com/gaming/comment/japan-import-namco-bandai-making-psp-dating-sim-starring-akb48-AKB1-48-Idol/]Gamertell.com[/url]]
translation:
在《AKB1/48：与偶像恋爱的话……》中，AKB48的48名少女全都爱上了身为主人公的你。她们可不会等你主动追求，而是争相幸福地倾诉自己有多么爱你。问题在于，你只能选择其中一人。因此，你必须避开另外47名少女，才能与心仪的对象走到一起。

[摘自[url=http://www.gamertell.com/gaming/comment/japan-import-namco-bandai-making-psp-dating-sim-starring-akb48-AKB1-48-Idol/]Gamertell.com[/url]]
